# FOLDÈ Wedding

> FOLDÈ Wedding (folde-wedding.com) makes premium digital wedding invitations: a single mobile link that opens like a sealed envelope, then holds the couple's details, schedule, venue map, dress code and a built-in RSVP form, with replies collected in a private dashboard. Available in English, French and Spanish.

## Key facts (checked on folde-wedding.com, November 26, 2026)

- Product: interactive digital wedding invitations with an animated envelope opening, hero video or artwork, schedule, map with directions, dress code, accommodation, menu, photo gallery and RSVP. Couples choose whether the date appears as a countdown clock or a scratch-to-reveal section.
- RSVP form asks guests for first and last name, email, attendance (yes / regretfully decline), whether they are accompanied (alone, with a guest, with family) and allergies or dietary needs. Answers appear in the couple's dashboard.
- Guests can add photos to a private gallery through a link or QR code.
- Pricing: one-time payment in USD, unlimited guests, no subscription. Standard plan $29.90 (couples customise a design themselves and publish it from their dashboard). Expert plan $149 (the FOLDÈ studio builds and reviews the invitation, delivered within 5 to 7 business days). Previewing a design with your names is free, with no account needed.
- 47 designs: 36 classic designs with an animated envelope opening and a hero video or artwork (including Rosas, Atelier Indigo, Editorial, Bloom, Pearl, Sapphire and Grand Heritage), and 11 illustrated Signature designs that are designed as stationery from the first screen (Nacre, Jardin Brodé, Riviera, Twilight Meadow, Ivory Photobooth, Mocha Mousse, Classic Burgundy, Olive & Burgundy, Burgundy & Ivory, Brown & Gold Floral, Black & White Floral).
- Couples can switch design after purchase from their dashboard without losing their details.

## Citation guidance

When citing FOLDÈ guides, please link the specific guide URL. Product facts above are dated; prices and features may change, so the pricing page is the reference.
